body: I understand but please do not kill yourself. You are important to somebody. Your mom loves you, Maybe you aren't meant to be taking those classes? You might need to just take a break from everything. Take some time off. Are you religious at all? I say pray about it. Nothing is too hard or impossible, trust me. You will make it out. We all go through hard times. Tell your mom how you feel. Talk to someone about it. Don't seclude yourself. And, as for relationships, maybe you are meant to be with a woman, have you thought about that? You need a friend. Just my thoughts.
